simple.meaning: the little man of the eye; the pupil or ball ; hence, the middle (of night)
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אִישׁוֹן (H380) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 6 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: אִישׁוֹן (ʼîyshôwn) means the little man of the eye; the pupil or ball ; hence, the middle (of night) First listed occurrence: Deut 32 10.

definitions.short: the little man of the eye; the pupil or ball ; hence, the middle (of night)
definitions.full: H380. ishon אִישׁוֺן noun [masculine] pupil of eye (compare Dl HA 9 Prät LoPh, Feb. 1884 , but also Arabic , & Nö ZMG 1886, 739 ) — ׳א all construct — ׳א עַיִן Deut 32:10 ; Prov 7:2 ; ׳א בַּתעַֿיִן Psa 17:8 (in all, simile of preciousness); = middle, midst of night ׳בְּא וַאֲפֵלָה לַיְלָה Prov 7:9 ; ׳בְּא חשֶׁח 20:20 Kt i.e. in deep darkness (Qr בֶּאֱשׁוּן see Now). אִישַׁי see יִשַׁי . אֱשׁוּן Qr Prov 20:20 see אִישׁוֺן below אישׁ .
